mapper.select: with iv as ( select coalesce(nr.state_cat, s.state_cat) as cat, coalesce(nr.reason_cd, lr.reason_cd) as reason_cd, coalesce(nr.reason_nm, lr.reason_nm) as reason_nm, floor(extract(epoch from least(coalesce(s.end_at, #{until}::timestamptz), #{until}::timestamptz) - greatest(s.start_at, #{from}::timestamptz)))::bigint as sec from cms_equip_state_log s join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = s.equip_id left join cms_state_reason lr on lr.reason_id = s.reason_id left join cms_state_note n on n.state_log_id = s.state_log_id and n.void_yn = 'N' left join cms_state_reason nr on nr.reason_id = n.reason_id where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.start_at < #{until} and (s.end_at is null or s.end_at > #{from}) and (e.equip_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or e.equip_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\') ) select cat, reason_cd, max(reason_nm) as reason_nm, sum(sec) as sec, count(*) as intervals from iv where cat not in ('PRD', 'UNKNOWN') and sec > 0 group by cat, reason_cd order by sum(sec) desc, cat, reason_cd nulls last

select w.wo_id, w.wo_no, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, trim_scale(w.plan_qty)::text as plan_qty, w.plan_qty as plan_num, trim_scale(coalesce(g.good, 0))::text as good_qty, coalesce(g.good, 0) as good_num, w.unit_cd, w.plan_start, w.status from prd_wo w join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id left join lateral ( select sum(r.good_qty) as good from prd_result r where r.wo_proc_id = (select wp.wo_proc_id from prd_wo_proc wp where wp.wo_id = w.wo_id order by wp.op_seq desc limit 1) and r.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from prd_result v where v.reversal_of_id = r.result_id) ) g on true where w.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and w.plan_start >= #{from} and w.plan_start <= #{to} and w.status not in ('PLANNED', 'CANCELLED') order by w.plan_start, w.wo_no, w.wo_id limit #{limit}
